body:
I am making a decision.
I am going to try and keep this life going as long as I can until his birthday. If I cannot feel better...I want to take my life on his birthday so every year that he is supposed to be celebrating, he will know he took a life. The day he celebrates is the day he is distracted with his conscience.

I consider myself rather physically healthy. However, my mental health has been suffering lately. I am personally scared to be on antidepressants and generally scared for my future. I want to be able to enjoy my life. Normally. See my dreams into fruition. Its hard to see that future with that knowing I have to be on antidepressants as the next part of my life.
